prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a spray (sunless) salon or one with UV tanning beds? I can give a specific salon recommendation, but it helps to know:
- Which type you want (spray/airbrush vs. beds)
- What area of Charlotte you’re near (Uptown, South End, Ballantyne, etc.)
- Any other priorities (price, memberships, organic solutions, celebrity/bridal experience)

Meanwhile, quick guidance to pick the best salon:
- For spray tans: look for certified techs, airbrush (not just automated booths) and high-quality solutions (Norvell, Versa, Mystic). Read recent Google/Yelp reviews and ask for before/after photos. Ask about prep (exfoliation) and maintenance instructions.
- For UV tanning: check that beds are well-maintained, staff monitor sessions, protective eyewear is provided, and the salon posts cleaning protocols. Remember UV increases skin cancer risk; consider sunless options instead.
- Visit first if you can: check cleanliness, friendliness, and whether they do a patch test if you have sensitive skin.
- Compare prices and packages; many places offer first-timer specials.

If you tell me the type and neighborhood, I’ll recommend a few top-rated Charlotte salons and note what each is best for.
